description: Flip the cards and match all 8 emoji pairs — with a move counter, timer and win stats.

faqs.a: No, they're shuffled fresh every game with an unbiased Fisher–Yates shuffle.
faqs.q: Are the cards in the same place each game?

faqs.a: Flip any two cards. Match all 8 pairs to win. Mismatched cards flip back after a moment.
Yes — the timer starts on your first flip and stops when you match the last pair.

howto: Press Start (or just flip your first card).
Click two cards to flip them.
Matching pairs stay face-up; misses flip back.
Match all 8 pairs to see your time and move count.
title: Memory Match Game
